lens: Prospective client — factual comprehension (simulated AI lens)
reason: The inspected public offer is understandable: University of Michigan students provide research, analysis and recommendations, pro bono, usually over one semester with 6–8 members. The capabilities distinguish early product thinking from physical engineering delivery. Client responsibilities include time, context, information access and a responsive contact; scope and cadence are agreed together. The source-traced journey from Client Services through its fee FAQ to the contact form provides useful inquiry prompts and identifies the board as recipient. Supplied desktop/mobile home captures show coherent Precision Instrument hierarchy, a prominent client action and readable mobile hero copy. Publication approval boundaries are explicit, and confidentiality is discussed during scoping rather than presented as an existing agreement. However, named organizations do not establish the quality of MECG work, and the supplied revision has no approved project evidence. The recorded inquiry success uses intercepted HTTP, so it establishes local interface behavior rather than board receipt or observed client success. These limits prevent an unqualified world-class or release-readiness judgment.

findings.evidence: PUBLIC_PROJECTS is empty. Organization profiles explicitly say scope, methods, deliverables and outcomes await approval; work/page.tsx:56-63 omits Selected work when no public projects exist. The home capture likewise displays the pending-client-approval status. release-open-items.md confirms approved case studies and actual project artifacts remain absent.
findings.userImpact: A client can understand the proposed service but cannot judge whether prior MECG analysis or handoffs match the rigor and usefulness their own decision requires. Organization descriptions and logos supply affiliation context rather than inspectable consulting evidence.
findings.suggestedFix: Obtain client and board approval for at least one specific engagement question, methods, constraints and redacted handoff artifact, then publish through the existing release boundary. Describe only approved results; retain the honest pending state until approval exists.

notVerified: No hosted or staging inquiry was sent. tests/e2e/public-journeys.spec.ts:46 replaces /api/contact with a synthetic 200 response; the recorded desktop/mobile passes do not verify email-provider delivery, destination configuration or board receipt.
No prospective client participated. Comprehension, confidence, successful inquiry completion and the one-week reply promise in site-content.ts:181 were not observed or operationally verified.
Client permissions, partnership claims, NDA execution and actual project quality were not independently authenticated; no confidential client material was inspected.

Visual evidence is supplied home captures on the documented Linux/Chromium setup. No contact/work captures, physical-device, Safari, Firefox or assistive-technology validation was performed; private workflows were outside this seat’s focal assessment.
